6.336 rsInvalidNestedRecursiveAggregate
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
rsInvalidNestedRecursiveAggregate is a critical error that will occur when an aggregate function is
nested inside the Expression parameter to another aggregate function and specifies a value for the
Recursive parameter.
